Before resuming distributed training, a comprehensive set of checks must be performed to ensure consistency, data integrity, and fault tolerance across all participating processes. First, **model and optimizer state synchronization** must be verified. All ranks should confirm that they have identical model weights and optimizer states, typically validated through checkpoint loading and comparison. Any divergence can lead to incorrect gradients and poor convergence.
